Not yet—the current setup is local and uses provider API keys directly.

| Capability | Current state |
|---|---|
| Devenv tasks | None defined. [devenv.nix](/home/diogenes/Projects/baste/devenv.nix) is a starter template. |
| `devenv up` | No processes configured, so it won’t start the API, site, or Storybook. |

| Sign-in | No Not Organic authentication or session integration. |
| Models | Direct provider calls with configured keys; the Studio’s image-model list is hardcoded. |
| Payments | No checkout, wallet, billing, or entitlement integration. |

Running things currently relies on npm scripts and `baste gui`. The Studio connects to `localhost:3456/api`, falling back to demo mode when unavailable.
